Name: Intravenous Coffee
Author: imacomputr
Description:
[size=5]Intravenous Coffee[/size]

[size=2]Do you love coffee? Do you crave that +1 Speed boost, but don't have time to constantly chug it down every 2 minutes? Hook it straight to your veins! Our patented slow-drip technology releases a steady stream of coffee into your bloodstream, so you never have to pause to take another sip. Enjoy a permanent +1 Speed boost - as long as you have a coffee supply. Be careful, it's addictive![/size]

[color=#00ff00]Update:[/color][color=#616161] [/color][color=#efefef]Now compatible with Stardew Valley 1.3.[/color]

[size=5]What it does[/size]
[size=2]
This mod adds a new item to the Doctor's office, the IV Bag. Put coffee in the attachment (like bait in a fishing pole). As long as it's in your inventory and filled with coffee, it will consume 1 coffee every 2 minutes to give you a +1 Speed boost. If you run out, or remove the IV drip, you'll suffer withdrawal: a -1 Speed debuff until you go to sleep.[/size]

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
